Facts read before this line (out/_analysis/d4a07_explore.py): of 6,634 placed selected lines, 2,125 are on arrows (restrict 1,811, add-condition 285, add-step 29) and 4,509 on elements (add-step 1,392, restrict 1,183, link 996, add-condition 938); restricts are 0.451 of all; an arrow line's evidence theme sits under the arrow's source element in 485 lines, under its target in 651, elsewhere in 989; every arrow end has a fourth-order anchor except P15 (anchored at FP-01).

D4a-07 rule, written before any clustering. REQUIRED, the arrow at every level. (1) An arrow line is a link from the arrow's source element to its target element (model/arrows.jsonl). Each end goes to the ladder through the element's anchors (model/elements.jsonl, tier): at the fourth-order level its fourth-order anchors, a third-order anchor taken up to the fourth-order theme that gathers it (fourth/fourth.jsonl); at the dimension, the dimension that holds that fourth-order theme (dimensions.jsonl); at the third-order level, the element's third-order anchors where it has them, otherwise the line's own evidence theme if that theme lies under the end's fourth-order anchor (the room's evidence sits at that end), otherwise the end is held at its fourth-order node. An end with no node at a level (P15, anchored at FP-01; a third-order anchor no fourth-order theme gathers) is held at its element. An element with several anchors splits the link's weight equally over the pairs. (2) Within each level an arrow line gives half its weight to its evidence node, as before, and half to its link; an element line gives all its weight to its node. Node and link columns held by only one defining room are dropped at each level. Everything else as at D4a-06: floor 5, shares within each level, Hellinger, the levels counting equally, Ward on the defining rooms. PROPOSALS, decided before the run: (a) placement by the whole mix (the Ward form for a defining room, the nearest centre for a thin one), the signatures (fourth-order nodes and links) used only to describe; J's literal rule reported beside it with the rooms that move; the weighting by distinctiveness declined as one more rule. (b) form B not dissolved by hand: a form is kept or split only by the stated measures; a form whose signatures are each held by under half its members is reported as a mixture, with what Ward's next split does to it. (c) the raiding core taken: rooms with a quarter or more of their selected changes on attack calls (T3-006 or T4-020); tested as one group by its silhouette against the rest, against 999 random groups of the same size among the defining rooms (seed 6), and by how it falls across the forms. (d) the count as at D4a-06: the merge-height gap and matched-subsample stability against a shuffled null; the stability cut carried, the gap's cut given if they disagree; a carried form with no signature is reported as such. (e) the floor of 5 kept. (f) restrict lines: the cut redone without them at the carried k, its sizes and adjusted Rand index against the main cut reported, and each form's share of restricts; weighting restricts apart declined, since op does not count on its own (J's first rule). (g) the link op taken as my own proposal: an element line with op link proposes a connection the model lacks, so it is lifted as a link the same way, from its evidence node to the element's anchor; the cut without these links (arrows only) reported as a check. (h) the reading as at D4a-06, with each form's op mix, and for each form whether an account that differs from the global model could be written.
